artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan to build orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh (both-engine per-task postflight with the ported mtime and dispatch_seq gates), resolving the writer-contract and return-meta dispatch_seq schema questions research left open.

memory_candidates.content: When a detection gate gains a suppression predicate (e.g. 'do not record a missing-artifact defect when this dispatch's writer was contractually not expected to produce one'), the fail-direction for an UNRECOGNIZED input must be chosen explicitly and paired with a loud named WARN, not left implicit. In this repo's orchestrator, an agent name absent from the contractual-handoff-writer allowlist is treated as a NON-writer (suppress the defect) because the overwhelming default is non-writers and recording-on-unknown reproduces exactly the spurious-defect bug the suppression exists to fix; the WARN naming the unrecognized agent is what keeps the allowlist gap visible instead of silent. Critically, the suppression is narrowed to the ABSENT case only -- a present-but-stale or present-but-identity-mismatched artifact still records unconditionally, so fail-open on the suppression predicate never widens into fail-open on the gate itself.
